user.title: Set up Event Blackbox
user.description:
Explains why an entity changed state, with clearly labelled evidence. A read-only debugging aid.

Setting up turns nothing on: no recording, no storage, no actions. Choose what to record and turn it on in the Event Blackbox panel in the sidebar.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Event Blackbox is already configured. Only a single instance is allowed.

init.title: Event Blackbox options
init.description:
Collection is off by default. When enabled, only the selected entities and domains are observed, kept in memory only and limited by count, size and age. Observed events can reveal household routines.

Tip: the Event Blackbox panel in the sidebar offers the same settings with search and grouping by area or type.

data_description.collection_enabled: Nothing is observed unless this is on and at least one entity or domain is selected.
data_description.domains: Sensitive domains (people, locations, cameras, locks, alarms, media) are not selected by default and need an extra confirmation. Broad domains such as sensor can also contain health or location values; numbers are never stored, but selecting single entities keeps the record smaller.
data_description.history_days: Off by default. When set, the recorded events are also stored in Home Assistant's storage for up to this many days, so they survive restarts. The file is not encrypted, is part of backups and is deleted when you set this to 0, turn collection off or remove the integration.

sensitive.title: Sensitive domains selected
